headline: Handshake AI Review: Jobs, Pay & Application Process (2026)
description: Handshake AI review covering available research on roles, pay, and positioning as a high-paying platform for expert-level AI work.

acceptedAnswer.text: A platform offering paid remote work for experts and generalists, with tasks in prompt engineering, output evaluation, and domain-specific reasoning assessment.

Cross-platform research groups Handshake AI with other high-paying platforms in a $50-$300+/hr range for STEM, coding, legal, medical, or finance expertise, though this figure is not confirmed as Handshake-specific.
Not documented in available research - this is a gap for dedicated future research.
